name: Braze
label: Braze — users, campaigns, Canvas, catalogs (REST)
description: Official Braze REST API. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Bearer rest API key. Packaged host is US-01 https://rest.iad-01.braze.com (document your cluster). user.delete is irreversible GDPR deletion. Customer owns the Braze workspace. api_key is never logged. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) + provider signing/verification config (webhook_secret, webhook_header_name) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: user.track | user.delete | user.export | campaign.trigger | canvas.trigger | subscription.set | catalog.upsert | message.send | trigger.listen. Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) and provider verification fields (webhook_secret, webhook_header_name), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Braze REST API key (workspace). Authorization: Bearer. Never log. Key permissions must match the operation (users.track, users.delete, …).

configurationParameters.label: Rest Endpoint
configurationParameters.description: Braze REST endpoint host of your instance, interpolated into https://{rest_endpoint}. Copy it from the Braze dashboard (Settings > APIs and Identifiers / API docs cluster table); host only, no scheme or path. Examples: rest.iad-01.braze.com (US-01, default), rest.iad-05.braze.com (US-05), rest.fra-01.braze.eu (EU-01), rest.au-01.braze.com (AU-01).

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Node-scoped API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node via full URL key (.../runtime/message-events/<apiKey>) or X-SQ-WEBHOOK-KEY header (verified alongside the provider's secret header).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Auth Header Secret
configurationParameters.description: Provider webhook secret verified in constant time against inbound header X-Braze-Webhook-Token. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Auth Header Name
configurationParameters.description: HTTP header name carrying the provider webhook secret (default: X-Braze-Webhook-Token).
